extraInstructions: Log in first with username "admin" and password "AqapDemo2026!" (the login form is at /dashboard, unauthenticated visits redirect there). This is a lightweight self-hosted uptime-monitoring tool (Uptime Kuma) — a small single-page app, not a large multi-domain system like the other descriptors here. Keep exploration to the listed routes; adding a test monitor or two is fine, this is a private local instance.
